cues.en: In the last lecture we worked on the virtual card utility functions.
cues.zh: 上一堂實作了虛擬卡工具函式。

cues.en: Let's now create the card related templates.
cues.zh: 現在建立卡片相關範本。

cues.en: The first one will be the card creation email template.
cues.zh: 第一個是卡片建立通知郵件。

cues.en: This will notify the customer of a successful card creation and pending activation.
cues.zh: 通知客戶卡片建立成功，目前等待啟用。

cues.en: So you can go to the Project Explorer.
Then you're going to go to backend up core.
Then you're going to go to emails, then templates, then create a new file that's going to be card
underscore created dot HTML, then create the txt version that's going to be card underscore created dot txt.
Then what you can do is we can open deposit a lot then copy that.

cues.en: Then go back to the card created, paste it in.
Then let's see we're going to make some changes.
Scroll to the top.
Then the title is going to change to Virtual Card created.
cues.zh: title 改為「虛擬卡已建立」。

cues.en: Then for the header we're going to change this to your virtual card has been created.
cues.zh: header 改為「您的虛擬卡已建立」。

cues.en: Then for the block content we're going to have the full name.
Then for this paragraph tag we're going to change the text and it's going to be your virtual card has been created successfully and is pending activation.
cues.zh: 這個 p 的文字改為「您的虛擬卡已成功建立，目前等待啟用」。

cues.en: Then we can say, here are your card details.
cues.zh: 再寫「以下是您的卡片詳細資料」。

cues.en: Then you're going to have the div.
The background color is going to remain the same with the padding, border radius and the margins.
cues.zh: 背景色、padding、border-radius 與 margin 都保持不變。

cues.en: Then the unordered list styling remains the same.
Then for the li now this text changes to card type.
cues.zh: li 的文字改為「卡片類型」。

cues.en: Then we're going to pass in the card type.
Then the card currency that's going to be currency.
As you can get rid of amount then the card number.
So you can change account name to card number.
Then we're going to pass in here the masked card number then the name on the card.
cues.zh: 帶入 masked_card_number，再來是卡片上的姓名。

cues.en: So you can say name on card.
Then we're going to pass in here name on card.
Then we're going to have the daily limit.
That's going to be we're going to pass in the currency then space then pass in the daily limit like that.
cues.zh: 帶入 currency，空格後再帶入 daily_limit。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the monthly limit as I can just copy daily limit paste it in.
cues.zh: 每月限額同樣處理，複製每日限額貼上。

cues.en: Then this changes to monthly.
Then we're going to pass in the currency.
Then this text changes to monthly limit like that.
Then we can get rid of this extra line like that.
cues.zh: 再移除這個多餘的項目。

cues.en: Then we're going to have another div.
So for the background color this time the background color changes to f three CD like that.
cues.zh: 背景色這裡原字幕辨識為 f3CD。

cues.en: Then the padding and the border radius remain the same.
Then you're going to have the paragraph style with the strong tags.
cues.zh: 接著是 p 與 strong 標籤。

cues.en: So within the strong tag we're now going to say important.
Then you can get rid of this text and say your card is currently inactive.
cues.zh: 移除原文字，寫「您的卡片目前尚未啟用」。

cues.en: Then you can say our account executives will review and activate your card shortly.
cues.zh: 再寫「客戶經理會盡快審核並啟用您的卡片」。

cues.en: Then you can say you'll receive another email once your card is activated and ready for use like that.
cues.zh: 「卡片啟用且可使用後，您會收到另一封郵件」。

cues.en: Then after the div, we're going to have another paragraph tag and you can say for security reasons,
cues.zh: div 後面再加入一個 p，寫「基於安全考量」。

cues.en: your card, a CVV will be provided separately upon activation like that.
cues.zh: 「卡片 CVV 將於啟用時另外提供」。

Now that we're done with the HTML template, let's work on the text version.
